description: Read an EXISTING MANUAL test case and return a recording guide the model uses to drive a live recording via the connected agent's granular tools (web_launch_application, web_snapshot, web_click, web_enter_text, …, core_close_session). The Electron recorder window opens automatically on web_launch_application; each captured step streams into it. The user reviews and clicks Save in the recorder — that CREATES A NEW automated test case (via POST /tm/testcase); the source manual TC is left untouched. Pass `url` unless the manual steps already contain one, and `extra` for credentials / data / what to assert. Read-only from MCP: this tool composes text, it never writes. Requires a live connection.

app_path.description: DESKTOP test cases only (tcType DESKTOP): the full path of the application's .exe. A DESKTOP test case needs no `url`; its guide uses the desktop_* tools. A manual test case still typed WEB (the MCP saved every manual test case as WEB before P11) also gets the DESKTOP guide when this is an .exe path.

extra.description: Extra guidance for the recording: credentials, data, assertions.

tcId.description: The manual test case id (or business key TC_123) to automate.

url.description: Starting URL for the recording (the app under test).

name: tc_automate
title: Turn a manual test case into a recording guide (creates a NEW automated TC)
